chapter_title_ka: ტარიელისა და ნესტან-დარეჯანის თათბირი და გამორჩევა
chapter_title_en: Counsel and Resolution of Tariel and Nestan-Darejan
chapter_expert_explanation_en: Tariel meets an indignant Nestan-Darejan, who condemns her parents' decision to hand the Indian throne to a foreign Khwarazmian prince rather than to Tariel, the rightful hereditary claimant and her sworn betrothed. Rejecting court intrigue, they resolve that Tariel will slay the bridegroom upon arrival and demand justice from King Parsadan (allegorizing 12th-century Georgian royal marriage debates).
